verdict.rationale: Sentry has automation-like features such as alerts and Seer-driven fix workflows, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence of versioning, review history, or rollback for those automations. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: dotagents version-locking covers agent skill dependencies, and sentry-cli release management covers application releases, not automation configs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
